name: mzizi
description: Build with Mzizi — an open-architecture project of the Bundu Foundation. Seven African Minerals palette, the open DNA-helix frontend architecture, Ubuntu doctrine, shadcn-compatible registry. Operated and developed by Nyuchi. Live at mzizi.dev. For the agent skills and the fundi scaffolding agent, install the mzizi plugin from nyuchi/mzizi-tools.
